# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 3 tokens; Text — 3 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 6 tokens; Borders and rings — 2 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 12 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 11 tokens; Radius — 5 tokens; Shadow — 3 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--surface-100);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `surface-100` | #faf7f2 | #1e1b18 | Page background and the base ground of every screen. Text on it: ink, ink-muted, ink-subtle. |
| `surface-200` | #fffdfa | #272320 | Raised surfaces: cards, popovers, input fields, message bubbles. Sits on surface-100. |
| `surface-300` | #f0ebe1 | #171512 | Sunken or recessed areas: code blocks, sidebars, table headers, hovered rows. Sits on surface-100. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--ink);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ink` | #2a2520 | #f3eee6 | Primary text and icons on surface-100, surface-200 and surface-300. |
| `ink-muted` | #5f574c | #bdb3a6 | Secondary text: captions, helper text, metadata on surface-100, surface-200 and surface-300. |
| `ink-subtle` | #766c5f | #9f9588 | Tertiary text and placeholders on surface-100 and surface-200 only. Lowest legible text; do not use on surface-300. |

## Color · Fills and status backgrounds

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--accent-hover);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (6)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accent-text` | #a04624 | #ee9c77 | Accent-colored text and links on surface-100, surface-200, surface-300 and accent-tint. |
| `accent-tint` | #f6e4db | #3a2418 | Soft accent background: selected rows, highlighted callouts, user message bubble. Text on it: ink or accent-text. |
| `accent-muted` | #e8b9a2 | #7a4129 | Decorative accent fill for shapes and illustrations (the cover, avatar grounds). Visible against surface-100 in both themes. Never a text ground. |
| `on-accent` | #ffffff | #1e1b18 | Text and icons placed on accent, accent-hover and accent-pressed. White in light, near-black in dark. |

**Interaction states** (same roles, suffixed):

| token | light | dark |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `accent-hover` | #9a4424 | #f09e78 |
| `accent-pressed` | #843a1e | #f7b08e |

## Color · Borders and rings

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--border-subtle);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `border-subtle` | #e6dfd3 | #38332d | Decorative hairlines: card edges, dividers, table rules. Never the only cue that a control exists (use border-control). |
| `border-control` | #8a7f6e | #7e7466 | Borders of interactive controls (inputs, outlined buttons, checkboxes). 3:1 or better on surface-100 and surface-200 in both themes. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--accent);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (12)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accent` | #b2502c | #e58e66 | The one warm brand color: primary button fill, selected states, key icons. Text on it: on-accent. As text on a surface use accent-text instead. |
| `neutral-tint` | #e6dfd3 | #3d3731 | Background for neutral badges and chips. Text on it: ink or ink-muted (5:1 or better in both themes). Stays visible on surface-100 in dark, unlike surface-300. |
| `scrim` | rgba(42, 37, 32, 0.45) | rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6) | Overlay behind modals and dialogs. Never put text directly on it. |
| `focus-ring` | #8f3f1e | #f0a67f | Solid 2px focus outline on every interactive element. 3:1 or better on surface-100, surface-200 and surface-300 in both themes. |
| `success` | #1f6a66 | #5cc2bb | Success text and icons on surface and success-tint. A blue-leaning teal, not green. Always paired with a check icon or the word. |
| `success-tint` | #e3f0ee | #17302e | Background for success badges and callouts. Text on it: success. |
| `danger` | #b3261e | #f28b82 | Error and destructive text and icons on surface and danger-tint. Always paired with an icon or the word, never color alone. |
| `danger-tint` | #fbe7e4 | #3a1f1d | Background for error badges and callouts. Text on it: danger. |
| `warning` | #8a5700 | #e3b15c | Warning text and icons on surface and warning-tint. Always paired with an icon or the word. |
| `warning-tint` | #f8ebd2 | #33290f | Background for warning badges and callouts. Text on it: warning. |
| `info` | #2f5d8c | #8fb8e8 | Informational text and icons on surface and info-tint. |
| `info-tint` | #e2ecf6 | #1a2a3d | Background for info badges and callouts. Text on it: info. |

## Type

Use the named styles; no literal px.

### Use

```css
font: var(--text-display-xl);            /* with tokens.css */
font-family: var(--font-serif);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display-xl` | `.display-xl`, `--text-display-xl` | 56px / 60px | 400 | `serif` | Landing hero and empty-state headline. One per screen, serif. |
| `display-lg` | `.display-lg`, `--text-display-lg` | 40px / 46px | 400 | `serif` | Page titles and section openers, serif. |
| `heading-1` | `.heading-1`, `--text-heading-1` | 30px / 36px | 500 | `serif` | Top-level heading inside a page or document, serif. |
| `heading-2` | `.heading-2`, `--text-heading-2` | 24px / 30px | 500 | `serif` | Section heading, serif. |
| `heading-3` | `.heading-3`, `--text-heading-3` | 20px / 26px | 500 | `serif` | Sub-section heading and card title, serif. |
| `body-lg` | `.body-lg`, `--text-body-lg` | 17px / 27px | 400 | `sans` | Long-form reading and conversation text. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 15px / 23px | 400 | `sans` | Default interface text and paragraphs. |
| `body-strong` | `.body-strong`, `--text-body-strong` | 15px / 23px | 600 | `sans` | Emphasis inside body copy and form labels. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 14px / 20px | 500 | `sans` | Buttons, tabs, menu items and form labels. |
| `caption` | `.caption`, `--text-caption` | 13px / 18px | 400 | `sans` | Helper text, timestamps, metadata. Use ink-muted. |
| `overline` | `.overline`, `--text-overline` | 12px / 16px | 600 | `sans` | Small uppercase category labels in ink-muted. The token cannot set casing: add the .overline class from bundle.css, or text-transform: uppercase. Use sparingly. |
| `code` | `.code`, `--text-code` | 14px / 22px | 400 | `mono` | Code blocks and inline code on surface-300. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `serif` | `--font-serif` | `"Newsreader", "Iowan Old Style", Georgia, serif` |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `"DM Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `"JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace` |

## Spacing

4px base. Every gap, padding and margin is one of these steps.

### Use

```css
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (11)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `space-1` | 4px | Icon-to-text gap, tight badge padding. |
| `space-2` | 8px | Gap between related controls, button vertical padding. |
| `space-3` | 12px | Input padding, gap inside a list item. |
| `space-4` | 16px | Default component padding and gap between stacked fields. |
| `space-5` | 20px | Card padding on mobile. |
| `space-6` | 24px | Card padding on desktop, gap between cards. |
| `space-8` | 32px | Gap between groups inside a section. |
| `space-10` | 40px | Section padding on mobile. |
| `space-12` | 48px | Gap between sections. |
| `space-16` | 64px | Section padding on desktop. |
| `space-24` | 96px | Page-level vertical rhythm on marketing pages. |

## Radius

### Use

```css
/* var(--radius-sm) */
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `radius-sm` | 6px | Badges, small chips, inline code. |
| `radius-md` | 10px | Buttons, inputs, menu items. |
| `radius-lg` | 16px | Cards, popovers, callouts, message bubbles. |
| `radius-xl` | 24px | Large panels, composer, modals. |
| `radius-pill` | 999px | Pills, toggles, avatars, filter chips. |

## Shadow

Soft, warm, low. Prefer borders; use shadow only to lift floating layers.

### Use

```css
/* var(--shadow-sm) */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `shadow-sm` | 0 1px 2px rgba(60, 40, 20, 0.06) · dark: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) | Resting cards that need a hint of lift. |
| `shadow-md` | 0 4px 16px rgba(60, 40, 20, 0.08) · dark: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) | Dropdowns, popovers and the message composer. |
| `shadow-lg` | 0 12px 40px rgba(60, 40, 20, 0.14) · dark: 0 12px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55) | Modals and dialogs. |
